messages:
lena-cs: Heads-up 1 min ago NebulaPulse hit regional throttles during a partner-run demo. They9re asking for a short-lived rate lift + allowlist for EU and APAC while onboarding finishes. Case opened: 802211.

sam-ops: What exact QPS and CIDRs? Window duration?

lena-cs: Case 802211 details: EU -> 4200 qps (current ~1000), APAC -> 1600 qps (current ~500). Window 96 hours (4 days) starting now. Egress CIDRs: 44.55.128.0/17 (EU) and 9.145.64.0/20 (APAC). They asked routing to eu-north + apac-tok edges. Also asked we capture per-region request logs for the demo for postmortem.

tom-network: I recommend L7 allowlist for EU and L4 for APAC (they NAT behind a partner LB). If this becomes persistent we'll need ASN/peering info. For now I can create an ephemeral EU L7 rule and an APAC L4 ACL entry. TTL = 345600s (96h). Will tag 'customer:nebulapulse' and add auto-revoke.

rita-eng: Which route/model? For stability during the burst set max_concurrency=10, cap max_tokens=600, and enable prefix caching and warm KV cache with their common demo prompts. Recommend fallback route to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if the 70b gets constrained. Also advise enabling short-circuit retries on 5xx to reduce client-facing errors.

lena-cs: Route: np-assistant-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. Customer accepts fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4.

mike-sales: Renewal for NebulaPulse is in 12 days. This demo matters for the expansion conversation; please flag any infra hiccups in the case and send me the logs.

policy-bot: Case 802211-ephemeral-allowlist created by lena-cs. Assigned: tom-network. SLA: 3h.

tom-network: Applying hybrid rules now. Plan: EU L7 ephemeral rule (TTL=345600), APAC L4 ACL entry (TTL=345600), map CIDRs to eu-north/apac-tok pools. Rolling apply ~3m.

sam-ops: After apply please run a smoke curl we can hand to the customer and paste to the case. Use this example pointing at chat endpoint:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"np-assistant-prod","input":"health check","max_tokens":8}'
```

tom-network: Done  ACLs applied. Verified 200 from test IP 44.55.130.7 hitting eu-north gateway; verified 200 from 9.145.64.12 on apac-tok gateway. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2024-10-08T12:30:00Z.

rita-eng: I kicked a KV warmup job using their demo prompts and set max_concurrency=10 + max_tokens=600 for the route. Also enabled short-circuit retries.

sam-ops: Ran a small synthetic load run at a 1000qps pilot slice (representative of demo traffic): p50 78ms, p95 310ms, p99 720ms under the burst config. No redispatch queueing observed. Will keep monitoring p99 and tail.

lena-cs: Captured region-specific request logs and pasted to case per customer ask (see /case/802211/logs). Noted their feedback: they saw occasional ~800ms spikes when demo included long context. Captured that in the case for the SRE debrief.

mike-sales: Thanks team 44f Added Renewal Watch to the case and pinged the AE. I'll follow up with NebulaPulse after the demo.

tom-network: Marked rules with tag 'ephemeral:nebulapulse-802211' and set auto-cleanup.

rita-eng: Also added a temporary runtime fallback policy pinned to the 13b-q4 route if backend queueing > 5% over 2m. That should reduce user-facing errors.

sam-ops: Pasted smoke outputs and curl example into the case and emailed the customer the test snippet.

lena-cs: Notifying NebulaPulse now that the bump + allowlist are live and that we captured logs. Scheduled a 30-min post-demo call to review perf and next steps. Closing loop with Sales after the call.
